question.text: The number of all three elements subsets of the set $\left\{a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3} \ldots a_{n}\right\}$ which contain $a_{3}$ is

solution.text: The number of three elements subsets containing $\mathrm{a}_{3}$ is equal to the number of ways of selecting 2 elements out of $\mathrm{n}-1$ elements. So, the required number of subsets is ${ }^{\mathrm{n}-1} \mathrm{C}_{2}$
